## Teaching points

1. Persistent pain with fever and gallbladder inflammation differs from a resolved biliary colic attack.
2. Give analgesia, replace losses and begin appropriate antibiotics while arranging surgical care.
3. Early cholecystectomy is definitive management when the patient is fit; liver-test abnormalities may prompt assessment for duct stones.
